prompt.project_info: Create a raw photorealistic three-quarter-body living-room portrait of an approved adult woman, preserving dark skin, voluminous butterfly-cut hair, oversized graphic tee, biker shorts, glasses, and deep focus.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult dark-skinned woman with long voluminous slightly messy black butterfly-cut hair, visible strands, natural pores, fine vellus hair and realistic skin irregularities, bright genuine smile and dimples. Wear an oversized graphic T-shirt with black matte biker shorts, transparent glasses, and hold a black smartphone in a transparent fingerprinted case.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing casually and leaning slightly back against a wall with one foot behind, one hand near the hip, photographed by another person in a three-quarter-body frame. Include neutral couch, coffee table, wall art, floor lamp, and fully sharp architectural background. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor ambient light mixed with phone-screen glow, even illumination, realistic jaw and clothing-fold shadows, no harsh flash, authentic daily mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital SLR or high-end smartphone rear-camera look, vertical 9:16, deep focus resembling f/11, visible fabric weave and natural sensor grain, no background blur.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Raw photorealistic vertical 9:16 three-quarter-body living-room portrait of an approved dark-skinned adult woman with long voluminous slightly messy black butterfly-cut hair, visible strands, natural pores, fine vellus hair, realistic skin irregularities, bright genuine smile and dimples. She wears an oversized graphic T-shirt, black matte biker shorts, transparent glasses, and holds a black smartphone in a transparent fingerprinted case. Standing casually against a wall with one foot behind and one hand near the hip. Neutral couch, coffee table, wall art, floor lamp, fully sharp background, soft indoor ambient light with phone-screen glow, natural daily lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, background blur, bokeh, AI smoothing, airbrushed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, distorted phone, watermark, invented text
